integrity: Exact finite symbolic and graph checks supplement, but do not replace, the analytic proof. The dated preprint is the earliest precisely date-verified public source anchor; an earlier contextual paper is known by publication year only.
scientific_limitations: Only three colours, threshold two, synchronous updates and finite friendship graphs. Other graph families, different thresholds, and the full first-entry-time census are not resolved. Historical priority remains subject to further literature inspection.
title: Three-step collapse and the exact oscillation basin of threshold-two cyclic dynamics on friendship graphs
